claims.statement: Boros is the white-red guild of Ravnica, framed around martial justice, honor, and peacekeeping.
The official guide describes Boros as the military and peacekeeping arm of Ravnican society.
Boros is organized as a military-style hierarchy designed to keep peace and enforce law.
The 2018 guide presents Aurelia as guildmaster and describes her preference for fighting alongside Boros troops.
The parun Razia is the original founder and first leader of the Boros Legion.
Mentor is the Guilds of Ravnica signature mechanic associated with Boros.
Boros placement signals should weight protection, moral urgency, teamwork, and willingness to act.
The Legion is split into two primary arms: the League of Wojek (police and investigators) and the Boros Army (martial defense).
Leadership transitioned from Razia to the angel Feather (Pierakor), and later to Aurelia.
The guild operates out of Sunhome (fortress-barracks) and utilizes the sky-fortress Parhelion II.
Agrus Kos (Wojek investigator) and Tajic (Legion commander) represent the two ideological halves of the guild.
Battalion and Radiance reflect the guild's belief in group synergy and widespread moral influence.
